experiments.title: Known-attack classification, strong tabular baseline
experiments.hypothesis: A tuned gradient-boosted baseline sets the number any deep model must beat.
experiments.measures: macro-F1, per-class recall, PR-AUC, confusion matrix
experiments.note: Measured numbers live in MODEL_CARD.md (full_v1 run).

experiments.title: Unknown-anomaly baseline (tabular AutoEncoder)
experiments.hypothesis: Reconstruction error trained on benign traffic separates unseen attacks.
experiments.measures: AUROC, AUPRC, recall at fixed FPR, normal FPR

experiments.title: Flow Transformer without pretraining
experiments.hypothesis: The architecture alone, with no MFM signal, is the honest floor.

experiments.title: MFM pretraining + classification head
experiments.hypothesis: Self-supervised pretraining improves the same architecture (E03 vs E04).
experiments.measures: macro-F1, per-class recall, delta against E03

experiments.title: MFM pretraining + anomaly head only
experiments.hypothesis: Reconstruction error from the shared encoder is a usable anomaly channel.
experiments.measures: AUROC, AUPRC, recall at fixed FPR, normal FPR

experiments.title: Dual-channel risk fusion
experiments.hypothesis: Classification and anomaly channels are complementary, not redundant.
experiments.measures: fusion precision/recall against each channel alone

experiments.title: Open-set evaluation by attack family
experiments.hypothesis: Family holdout is the only defensible measure of 'unknown attack' ability.
experiments.measures: unknown-family recall, AUROC, AUPRC, recall at fixed FPR

experiments.title: Out-of-time and cross-host generalisation
experiments.hypothesis: Random splits overstate performance; time and host holdouts expose it.
experiments.measures: macro-F1, per-class recall per split strategy

experiments.title: Rule replay and benign regression under real Suricata
experiments.hypothesis: LLM-authored rules only earn trust by passing a real engine and PCAP replay.
experiments.measures: target hits, benign false positives, load-test result
experiments.status: blocked: needs the Suricata binary on PATH
experiments.note: Needs the Suricata binary and an annotated PCAP corpus; recorded as blocked until then.

experiments.title: RAG citation correctness
experiments.hypothesis: The Agent's rules must cite retrievable, permitted knowledge.
experiments.measures: Recall@K, MRR, citation correctness, refusal rate
experiments.status: blocked: needs an LLM/embedding provider key
experiments.note: Needs a real embedding/LLM provider; the default hashing embedder is lexical only.
